source_checked: Menges Waller & Gawler 1986 seed set and seed predation in Pedicularis furbishiae
evidence_recovered: Immature scapes were enclosed by aluminum mesh for an unrelated experiment; cages were removed before flowers opened, and later lepidopteran seed predation matched uncaged plants. Authors inferred seed-predator attack occurred after pollination.
why_not_direct: This is a Pedicularis timing precedent only. The mesh was removed before flowering and therefore did not test whether a post-pollination barrier selectively reduces seed-predator access.
next_recovery_action: Use this to support the timing premise for G3; focal P. rex still requires post-pollination barrier effectiveness/selectivity validation with water-y fixed.
